dct_description_sm: GPR raw datset obtain in St. Liguori across the St. Liguori scarp. Certain choices were made in order to interpret the dataset (such as a velocity of 165m/ns). One could decide to reinterpret the data based on a different velocity or different gain, topographic correction, etc. Analysis for this dataset was submitted to seismica.
